behaviorChanges: Plan-review recovery: sha-stale-at-cap now decides whether the hard cap is reached from the next round NUMBER (one past the highest round any run reached), mirroring the round-cap gate, instead of the raw successful-run count. Same-round reruns that accumulate to the hard-cap count no longer mis-route a still-available R3/R4 convergence round to a successor plan.

requiredMigrations.command: gh auth refresh --hostname github.com -s read:project -s project
requiredMigrations.description: Carried forward from 0.10.3 for lanes updating across it: grant the gh token the GitHub Projects scopes the fail-closed board gates need. Machines already on 0.10.3+ or whose token carries read:project and project need no action.

rollbackNotes: Pinning back to 0.10.6 restores the record-count hard-cap approximation, which can mis-route a fix-after-blockers convergence round to a successor plan when same-round reruns have accumulated; no on-disk state moves.
